question: Are full-generate 32-minus-1 token deltas compatible with BF16 streaming-weight supply, and does a two-real-request batch amortize that cost?

hypotheses.H1: Streaming weight supply: one full dense weight pass per decode step; ideal B2 shares one pass across two requests. A ratio near1 is compatible but also possible under H2.
hypotheses.H2: Compute, launch/scheduling, padded graph dispatch, sampling/logprobs or other execution changes may explain deltas/batch response; no resource-only causal axis.
hypotheses.H3: Model/input/backend/dtype/graph or actual scheduling identity mismatches invalidate the structural comparison; STOP runtime/numeric failures.

numeric.tokens: Exact lengths and exact same-source tokens across repetitions and B1/B2 at same output length
numeric.logprobs: All returned finite; sampled per-step abs(delta)<=0.05+0.01*abs(reference)
numeric.historical_A00_32: Pinned MP02_A reference exact tokens and sampled logprobs, B1 and B2; A01 has self-repeatability plus B1/B2 crosscheck, no independent oracle

timing: pre-sync; CUDA-event start; one llm.generate; event stop; post-sync; event elapsed. Host generate-call wall separately (excludes post-sync), plus synchronized host request wall.

analysis.statistics: 5-sample median and unscaled MAD; all raw samples; no posthoc point selection
analysis.descriptive_envelope: abs(delta)>max(0.05*min(two medians),3*sum(two MADs)); ratio no causal classification
analysis.weight_model: Conditional traffic/bandwidth bound only, not measured DRAM; signed deltas include prefill and graph effects

stops: Any eager/weak/fallback backend or non-BF16/quantized path
Formal compile/capture or absent32-token graph replay
Unknown/foreign GPU process or resource overrun
next_candidate: Only if concrete residual cost and a new falsifiable hardware variable exist after software exclusion; never automatic.

G0_validation.capacity: CPU scheduler source fields and544*2=1088; live engine config/backend must pass after lock.
G0_validation.engineering: Fixed one Python source transport newline before admission, no science change.
